g.text: M5 Ultra · throughput vs complete-request latency
Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 · 19 input / 32 output · correctness-gated evidence · 256 GiB
Better = upper left. Historical concurrency and latest C1 are separate measurements.
Large marks: medians of three fresh process medians. Faint marks: every process; no confidence intervals.
A: filled marks and lines show each engine’s measured nondominated configurations; hollow marks retain regressions.
B: fixed 32-token C1 requests make throughput = 32 / latency(s); this is a slice, not a concurrent sweep.
Independent axes and rounds; historical native and external runs were not contemporaneously paired.
Historical external C1 excluded because interference exclusion is unproven. Per-engine correctness contracts apply; cross-engine token identity is not established.
